execution_notes: First execution attempt (18:0x window) hit a sustained real OpenAI API slowdown: production's own OpenAI client timeout (lib/searchRewrite.ts TIMEOUT_MS=8000, SDK default retries) combined to produce ~24-25s worst-case exhaustion; 14 of 23 runs (L05-L18) hit this on the first pass.

Runs were re-attempted (reusing the 9 already-successful results, never re-spending API calls on runs that already succeeded) with up to 3 fresh attempts per still-failing run in a second pass; 2 more (L05, L06) succeeded, 12 (L07-L18) still failed all 3 attempts in that pass.

A third, full re-run (reusing all 11 already-successful results) succeeded on all remaining 12 runs on the first attempt each -- confirming the earlier failures were a genuine transient OpenAI-side degradation window, not a harness or production code defect. No harness timeout values or production code were modified to achieve this; only time/retries were needed.
Final compiled CSV (stage7_guard_live_results_prompt2d_2026-07-14.csv) reflects the fully successful run: 23/23 runs completed with real LLM output, 0 errors, 0 timeouts.
